caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a cylindrical container with a slightly flared base and a wooden stick protruding vertically from its center. The surface of the container is mottled with various shades of reddish-brown and dark brown, giving it a textured appearance. The container has two horizontal bands encircling its midsection and base and a slightly indented rim at the top. The wooden stick is cylindrical, light brown, and tapers slightly at the tip. The background is plain and beige, with a faint rectangular border framing the drawing. The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Churn
